title: Tarot Table
tagline: A phone companion for a real tarot deck: tap in the card you drew, read what it means there, and ask the question it gives you.
readinessNote: The whole deck is data: 78 cards in one JSON list (Data/Cards), each with keywords, a meaning right way up and upside down, and a question for each. The spreads and their positions are another list (Data/Spreads). Rewrite the voice or add a spread without touching the graph. It installs on a phone and works offline (pwa/).
buildYourOwn: Your own voice for the cards, new spreads, another language, a different deck's names (Thoth, Marseille).
